caption: The drawing depicts two objects against a light beige background. The first object, positioned toward the lower center, is a single, worn-out brown shoe with visible creases and a darker toe area, suggesting signs of use and age. The shoe's inner lining is a lighter tan color, and the outer upper section shows areas of scuffed brown material. Directly above the brown shoe, there is a second object resembling an off-white or beige wooden shoe last, depicted with a slightly angled view that shows part of the inside as well as the top. The shoe last is smoother with subtle horizontal grooves along its surface. Both objects are surrounded by a soft, light brown gradient shadow that gently radiates outward from where they are positioned. In the lower right corner of the drawing, the name "Stanley Mazur" is written in neat, small, uppercase letters.
title: Woman's Sabot
